title: Thimsy device.json
description: One product's hardware facts, read by the image build, thimsy-session, thimsy-padd and Nano (docs/linux/IMPLEMENTATION.md E.7, F). thimsy-import writes the facts it can read from ROCKNIX into linux/generated/<family>/devices/<id>.json; board/<family>/devices/<id>.json is Thimsy's own (hand-written) document for the product. Only draft-07 keywords that linux/tools/thimsy-import/thimsy_import/devicejson.py validates are used: type, enum, const, pattern, minLength, minimum, maximum, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, properties, required, additionalProperties, patternProperties, propertyNames, items, $ref, anyOf.

id.description: Product id: the DTB name without its SoC prefix (anbernic-rg-arc-d), or a Thimsy name for targets without a DTB.

family.description: Hardware-pack family, lower case (rk3566, h700, qemu-aarch64-virt).

soc.description: ROCKNIX's HW_CPU option, or the SoC's name.

model.description: The device-tree model string the device is matched by at run time (/proc/device-tree/model).

model_source.description: Where the model came from; name-match is a guess the importer made from the DTB name.

dtb.description: <vendor>/<name>.dtb, or null when the firmware provides the device tree (QEMU).

images.description: ROCKNIX sub-images (config.xml) that carry this DTB; empty for a family-level image.

bluetooth.description: The device has a Bluetooth controller. Only a device where it is true gets BlueZ, D-Bus and D35bluetooth in its root (the tier's bluetooth.erofs, unpacked by card assembly; decision OA-15), and every board/<family>/devices/<id>.json states it. thimsy-prop boot writes it to ro.thimsy.device.bluetooth; D35bluetooth starts D-Bus and bluetoothd only when it is true and the user turned Bluetooth on. Absent: false.

modules.description: Kernel modules the kernel does not load by itself, loaded by S03modules in this order; thimsy-prop boot writes them to ro.thimsy.modules, space-separated.

product.description: Android's product identity for Nano's device matching (decision I24): thimsy-prop boot writes ro.product.{,vendor.,odm.}<field> and ro.board.platform from it, falling back to model (model), id (device, name) and family (platform).

props.description: Extra read-only properties, written as given by thimsy-prop boot (only ro.* keys; build.props wins a clash).

status.description: imported: facts only, nothing built; then the catalog levels of plan section 8.3.

quirk_facts.description: ROCKNIX quirk KEY=value facts not mapped to a field above, as plain strings (never shell text).

rocknix.description: Where the facts were read: ROCKNIX tag, commit and paths.

notes.description: Free notes keyed by the JSON pointer of the field they qualify ('' for the whole document). A note starting with 'guess' marks the value as unverified.

input_code.description: An EV_KEY code by its name in include/uapi/linux/input-event-codes.h; aliases (BTN_A) are written as their canonical name (BTN_SOUTH).

pad_button.description: The normalised layout padd emits (kernel Documentation/input/gamepad.rst). BTN_DPAD_* name the d-pad directions; padd emits them as ABS_HAT0X/ABS_HAT0Y. A KEY_* target is passed through on padd's keyboard side.

width.description: Native (scan-out) width in pixels, before rotation.

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation that turns the native mode into the landscape image the user sees.

rotation_source.description: The rotation contract (plan 5.3): the DRM property first, then fbcon, then this file.

match.description: How an evdev node is recognised: all given fields must equal the node's (EVIOCGNAME, EVIOCGPHYS, EVIOCGUNIQ, EVIOCGID).

calibration.description: Raw range of one axis; padd rescales it to the output range. Omitted values come from EVIOCGABS.

trigger.description: An analog trigger; a digital one is a button mapped to BTN_TL2/BTN_TR2.

required.description: padd waits for this node before presenting the pad (default true).

grab.description: EVIOCGRAB the node (default true for input roles).

hide.description: Unlink the node from devtmpfs after opening it (default true).

producer.description: padd merges the listed sources into the Thimsy Gamepad; kernel-joypad: one kernel node (rocknix-joypad) that padd re-exposes under the same identity.

buttons.description: Source code -> normalised code. With producer padd a source code not listed is dropped; with producer kernel-joypad an empty list passes the node's codes through unchanged.

label.description: The printed label on the button.

face_layout.description: Label convention (controller_layout_plan.md); saturn: the ARC's A B C / X Y Z print.

labels.description: Printed label of each normalised button.

button.description: The hotkey button Nano and RetroArch use.

control.description: Mixer control that selects the output path.
